what_it_is: Local benchmark proof subsystem that runs the Codex corpus, publishes a conservative multi-profile report, and regenerates the maintained README graph set from that same report.
why_tracked: Makes Odylith's measured quality, speed, and token-efficiency claims auditable as a first-class governed subsystem instead of a loose mix of scripts, reports, and README edits.
